Pocket Shell: the @ in color

At-mark #1 (the heavy mono @, no tail) on 15 backgrounds. Each shows 168px, then 64, 32 and 16px on light and dark, plus the real 16px PNG blown up. 48px and below use a bigger @ and drop texture and stitching so it stays crisp. Contrast is the lowest mark-to-background ratio: WCAG AA needs 3:1 for an icon, 4.5:1 if the pair is reused for text.
